title: Settings
description: Appearance, operation identity and local service.
displayNote: Changes apply immediately in this browser.
themeNote: Follow the system, or choose light or dark.
densityNote: Adjust spacing in lists and controls.
sidebarNote: The collapsed rail keeps navigation available.
languageNote: Applied to localized pages and controls.
identityNote: This name identifies future operations. It is not a login account.
serviceNote: Based on the last health check, independent of event sync.
